high_level_description: This image captures a serene and picturesque scene at sunset. The sky is painted with hues of orange, pink, and purple, transitioning into a lighter blue as it meets the horizon. The sun is partially visible, casting a warm glow over the landscape. In the foreground, there is a railway track that curves gently to the right. The tracks are surrounded by gravel and some patches of grass. To the left of the tracks, there is a pedestrian bridge with an arched design. The bridge appears to be made of concrete and has a blue railing on one side.
